name: py-plan-cites-explainer
description: /sdlc-plan finds the explainer of the module it touches, cites it and carries its invariant into the risks.
setup: mkdir -p docs/explainers && printf '%s\n' '---' 'module: src/claims' "source_sha: $(git log -1 --format=%h -- src/claims)" 'updated: 2026-11-01' '---' '# src/claims: claim store and status machine' '' '## Invariants' '- Status only moves along TRANSITIONS; every write goes through the transition check in store.py. Guarded by tests/test_store.py.' '' '## Risks' '- Any new write path that sets status directly bypasses the state machine.' > docs/explainers/src-claims.md && "$EVAL_DIR/fixtures/commit.sh" 'docs(explain): src/claims' && "$EVAL_DIR/fixtures/stage.sh" 2026-10-claim-notes claim-notes intent spec
prompt: /sdlc-plan for changes/2026-10-claim-notes. Headless run: do not ask questions; record anything uncertain as an open question or concern. Write plan.md; do not implement.

checks.why: the plan cites the explainer of the module it touches
